description: This source file defines and manages plugin facade modules, providing functions to load, generate, and organize various plugin SDK facades for different extensions. It handles dynamic import generation, source resolution, and export organization for a modular plugin architecture.

methods.name: pluginSource
methods.description: Constructs a plugin source string given directory name and artifact basename.

methods.name: runtimeApiSourcePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the runtime API source file for a given plugin directory.

methods.name: resolveFacadeLoadPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the load policy for a given facade entry and source path.

methods.name: resolveFacadeSourceTypescriptPath
methods.description: Resolves the corresponding TypeScript file path for a facade source, given the repository root.

methods.name: resolveFacadeModuleResolutionContext
methods.description: Provides TypeScript compiler host and options context for resolving facade modules.

methods.name: resolveFacadeSourceExportKinds
methods.description: Analyzes a source file to determine the kinds of exports it contains, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeModule
methods.description: Generates the module code for a plugin SDK facade entry, including dynamic import functions and export proxies.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeTypeMapModule
methods.description: Creates a TypeScript interface module mapping facade subpaths to their imported types and source modules.
